findings.title: Brace-prefixed raw or incomplete custom input loses all streaming deltas across direct, HTTP, WebSocket, and Chat conversion paths
findings.root_cause: responsesCustomToolInputDelta treats every accumulated argument string whose left-trimmed first byte is '{' as wrapper JSON and returns an empty delta until the entire value is valid JSON. unwrapCustomToolInput later falls back to the raw argument string when JSON is incomplete, or strips any valid top-level input member, so streaming and terminal interpretations disagree for valid raw brace-prefixed custom input and malformed/incomplete wrappers.

concrete_reproduction.request: OpenAI Responses request declaring custom tool patch.
concrete_reproduction.upstream_sequence: response.output_item.added for fc_1/patch, then one-byte response.function_call_arguments.delta fragments of the raw input, followed by function_call_arguments.done/output_item.done/completed carrying the same full argument string.
concrete_reproduction.direct_translator: TestAdversarialRawBracePrefixedInputLifecycleConsistency failed: custom delta concatenation was empty while terminal input was {diff --git a/file b/file.
concrete_reproduction.codex_http: TestAdversarialHTTPRawBracePrefixedCustomInput failed: HTTP custom delta concatenation was empty, wanted the raw input.
concrete_reproduction.codex_websocket: TestAdversarialWebSocketRawBracePrefixedCustomInput failed: WebSocket custom delta concatenation was empty, wanted the raw input.
concrete_reproduction.chat_to_responses: TestAdversarialChatRawBracePrefixedInput failed: Chat conversion emitted no custom input delta text while response.custom_tool_call_input.done contained the raw input.
concrete_reproduction.incomplete_wrapper: TestAdversarialIncompleteWrapperLifecycleConsistency failed for {"input":"diff: delta concatenation was empty while terminal input was the incomplete wrapper text.
concrete_reproduction.valid_raw_json: TestAdversarialRawJSONObjectInputIsPreserved failed for raw input {"input":"literal","other":1}: both delta and terminal paths returned literal instead of preserving the raw JSON object.

findings.impact: Custom tools accept arbitrary freeform input. Valid code, patches, or structured text may begin with '{'. Streaming clients then receive converted custom delta events with no input content, while done/output/completed report a non-empty value; valid raw JSON containing an input member can be silently truncated. The immutable revision therefore does not satisfy its arbitrary-fragmentation and raw-input fidelity boundary.

reviewer_notes: Producer/freezer claims were not used as proof; all trees, hashes, scope, application, and behavior were independently reconstructed or tested.
The immutable r03 evidence fixes every r02 baseline-manifest mismatch: all nine existing slice hashes now match the prepared base, P4-BASE r02 manifest/archive, and r03 baseline.tar.
The valid JSON-wrapper fragmentation fix works across direct translator, Codex HTTP, Codex WebSocket, and Chat-Completions-to-Responses, including byte splits inside keys and escapes.

Rejection is nevertheless required because the wrapper-detection heuristic is not safe for arbitrary raw custom input beginning with a brace and produces a stream/terminal mismatch on all affected paths.
Worktree isolation prevented updating the shared r03/review.json. The coordinator must copy this proposed review into the immutable evidence directory after verifying its SHA-256.
review_summary: REJECTED. Patch SHA, source/predecessor reconstruction, exact 12-file scope, every baseline manifest/archive file hash, prepared/result/reverse trees, 19 non-slice predecessor files, xAI stability, forward/reverse application, three planned-new removals, all frozen commands, race tests, prior collision/restoration/custom-lifecycle boundaries, valid arbitrary wrapper fragmentation, declaration ordering/collisions, mcp__ stability, output indices, and close-1009 behavior independently pass. A high-severity remaining defect misclassifies brace-prefixed raw or incomplete custom input as wrapper JSON, suppressing all streaming custom input deltas while terminal events expose a non-empty value across direct translator, Codex HTTP, Codex WebSocket, and Chat conversion paths; valid raw JSON containing an input member is also destructively unwrapped.
